startingCard.title: McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle first flies
startingCard.subtitle: Aircraft by McDonnell Douglas
startingCard.fact: The McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle is an American twin-engine, all-weather fighter aircraft designed by McDonnell Douglas.

cards.title: Neo Química Arena opens
cards.subtitle: Sports stadium
cards.fact: Arena Corinthians, also known as the Neo Química Arena for sponsorship reasons, is a sports stadium located in São Paulo, Brazil.

cards.title: Herbert Hoover becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: Herbert Clark Hoover was the 31st president of the United States, serving from 1929 to 1933.

cards.title: ‘Music’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Madonna
cards.fact: Music is the eighth studio album by American singer Madonna, released on September 18, 2000, by Maverick and Warner Bros.

cards.title: Ford Fusion Americas debuts
cards.subtitle: Car model by Ford Motor Company
cards.fact: The Ford Fusion is a mid-size car that was manufactured and marketed by the Ford Motor Company.

cards.title: Franchi SPAS-15 enters service
cards.subtitle: Firearm
cards.fact: The Franchi SPAS-15 is a dual-mode 12 gauge combat shotgun manufactured by the Italian company Luigi Franchi S.P.A.

cards.title: Se Cathedral is completed
cards.subtitle: Church in Velha Goa, India
cards.fact: The Sé Catedral de Santa Catarina, known as Se Cathedral, is the cathedral of the Latin Church Archdiocese of Goa and Daman and the seat of the Patriarch of the East Indies.

cards.title: Lebanese Civil War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Lebanese Civil War was a multifaceted armed conflict that took place from 1975 to 1990.

cards.title: ‘Transformers: Dark of the Moon’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Michael Bay
cards.fact: Transformers: Dark of the Moon is a 2011 American science fiction action film based on Hasbro's Transformers toy line.

cards.title: Ilyushin Il-14 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Avia
cards.fact: The Ilyushin Il-14 is a Soviet twin-engine commercial and military personnel and cargo transport aircraft that first flew in 1950, and entered service in 1954.

cards.title: ‘Brera Madonna’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Piero della Francesca
cards.fact: The Brera Madonna is a painting by the Italian Renaissance master Piero della Francesca, executed in 1472–1474.

cards.title: ‘King John’ premieres
cards.subtitle: Play by William Shakespeare
cards.fact: The Life and Death of King John, by William Shakespeare, is a history play about the reign of John, King of England, the son of Henry II and Eleanor of Aquitaine, and the father of Henry III.

cards.title: ‘Adoration of the Magi’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Leonardo da Vinci
cards.fact: The Adoration of the Magi is an unfinished early painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Leonardo da Vinci.

cards.title: ‘Black Sabbath’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Black Sabbath
cards.fact: Black Sabbath is the debut studio album by the English heavy metal band Black Sabbath, released on 13 February 1970 by Vertigo Records in the United Kingdom and on 1 June 1970 by Warner Bros.

cards.title: Erik the Red dies
cards.subtitle: Explorer and founder of the first viking settlement in Greenland
cards.fact: Erik Thorvaldsson, known as Erik the Red, was a Norse explorer, described in medieval and Icelandic saga sources as having founded the first European settlement in Greenland.

cards.title: Thomas Edison dies
cards.subtitle: American inventor and businessman
cards.fact: Thomas Alva Edison was an American inventor and businessman.

cards.title: May 68
cards.subtitle: Protest, riot, or uprising
cards.fact: May 68 was a period of widespread protests, strikes, and civil unrest in France that began in May 1968 and became one of the most significant social uprisings in modern European history.

cards.title: L3/35 enters service
cards.subtitle: Type of Tankette
cards.fact: The L3/35, also known as the Carro Veloce CV-35, was an Italian tankette that saw combat before and during World War II.

cards.title: Marcus Aurelius becomes Roman emperor
cards.fact: Marcus Aurelius Antoninus was Roman emperor from 161 to 180 and a Stoic philosopher.

cards.title: ‘Traffic’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Steven Soderbergh
cards.fact: Traffic is a 2000 American crime drama film directed by Steven Soderbergh and written by Stephen Gaghan.

cards.title: Philipp Lenard dies
cards.subtitle: German physicist
cards.fact: Philipp Eduard Anton von Lenard was a Hungarian–German experimental physicist who received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1905 for his work on cathode rays.

cards.title: Ahmad Shah Qajar becomes shah
cards.fact: Ahmad Shah Qajar was the shah of Iran (Persia) from 16 July 1909 to 15 December 1925, and the seventh and final ruling member of the Qajar dynasty.

cards.title: Edmonton Oilers is founded
cards.subtitle: NHL franchise
cards.fact: The Edmonton Oilers are a professional ice hockey team based in Edmonton.

cards.title: ‘Jurassic World Dominion’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Colin Trevorrow
cards.fact: Jurassic World Dominion is a 2022 American science fiction action film directed by Colin Trevorrow, who co-wrote the screenplay with Emily Carmichael.

cards.title: Alec Douglas-Home becomes prime minister of the United Kingdom
cards.fact: Alexander Frederick Douglas-Home, Baron Home of the Hirsel, known as Lord Dunglass from 1918 to 1951 and the Earl of Home from 1951 to 1963, was a British statesman and Conservative politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1963 to 1964.

cards.title: Charlotte Brontë dies
cards.subtitle: British novelist and poet
cards.fact: Charlotte Nicholls, commonly known by her maiden name Charlotte Brontë, was an English novelist and poet, and was the elder sister of Emily, Anne and Branwell Brontë.

cards.title: ‘Fallout’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American television series
cards.fact: Fallout is an American post-apocalyptic drama television series created by Graham Wagner and Geneva Robertson-Dworet for Amazon Prime Video.

cards.title: Antonov An-72 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Antonov
cards.fact: The Antonov An-72 is a transport aircraft, developed and produced by the Ukrainian aircraft manufacturer Antonov.

cards.title: Almohad Caliphate is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Almohad Caliphate or Almohad Empire was a North African empire ruled by a Berber Muslim dynasty in the 12th and 13th centuries.

cards.title: McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by McDonnell Douglas
cards.fact: The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II is an American tandem two-seat, twin-engine, all-weather, long-range supersonic jet interceptor and fighter-bomber that was developed by McDonnell Aircraft for the United States Navy.

cards.title: Jim Morrison dies
cards.subtitle: American singer and poet; lead vocalist of The Doors
cards.fact: James Douglas Morrison was an American singer-songwriter and poet who was the lead vocalist and primary lyricist of the rock band the Doors.
